module.purpose: Defines core Redux reducer type contracts and TypeScript inference helpers for deriving state, action, and preloaded-state shapes from reducer maps.
module.summary: This file is a pure TypeScript type-definition module that establishes the fundamental Redux reducer pattern at the type level. It declares the Reducer function signature, a ReducersMapObject mapping keys to reducers with a constraint that preloaded state keys must extend state keys, and a set of conditional/infer-based utility types that extract combined state, reducer union, action types, and preloaded-state shapes from a reducers map. The module is documentation-heavy, emphasizing that reducers must be pure functions free of side effects. It serves as the typing foundation for combineReducers and related Redux internals.
module.businessContext: Provides type safety for Redux state management. If broken, compile-time guarantees for reducers and store shape fail.

contractsProvided.name: Reducer
contractsProvided.shape: type Reducer<S = any, A extends Action = UnknownAction, PreloadedState = S> = (state: S | PreloadedState | undefined, action: A) => S

contractsProvided.name: ReducersMapObject
contractsProvided.shape: type ReducersMapObject<S = any, A extends Action = UnknownAction, PreloadedState = S> = keyof PreloadedState extends keyof S ? { [K in keyof S]: Reducer<S[K], A, K extends keyof PreloadedState ? PreloadedState[K] : never> } : never

contractsProvided.name: StateFromReducersMapObject
contractsProvided.shape: type StateFromReducersMapObject<M> = M[keyof M] extends Reducer<any, any, any> | undefined ? { [P in keyof M]: M[P] extends Reducer<infer S, any, any> ? S : never } : never

contractsProvided.name: ReducerFromReducersMapObject
contractsProvided.shape: type ReducerFromReducersMapObject<M> = M[keyof M] extends Reducer<any, any, any> | undefined ? M[keyof M] : never

contractsProvided.name: ActionFromReducer
contractsProvided.shape: type ActionFromReducer<R> = R extends Reducer<any, infer A, any> ? A : never

contractsProvided.name: PreloadedStateShapeFromReducersMapObject
contractsProvided.shape: type PreloadedStateShapeFromReducersMapObject<M> = M[keyof M] extends Reducer<any, any, any> | undefined ? { [P in keyof M]: M[P] extends (inputState: infer InputState, action: ActionFromReducersMapObject<M>) => any ? InputState : never } : never

export type ReducersMapObject<
  S = any,
  A extends Action = UnknownAction,
  PreloadedState = S
